releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.2.1

- NEW BACKEND: the leaderboard, usernames, and Oblivion Relic now run on Firebase (Auth + Firestore) instead of Supabase, with silent anonymous sign-in that persists across restarts.
- OBLIVION OVERHAUL: unlock threshold raised to 50 billion logs, entry fee raised to 25% of your balance, and two new all-in options — OPEN 5 and OPEN 50 (which also resets your Auto Clickers, Sawmills, and Steam Engines), both spending your entire log balance. OPEN 50 requires a 5-second warning confirmation.
- PRESTIGE EXPANDED: 5 new Prestige tiers (10 total). Each Prestige now also permanently reduces all earnings by 10%, stacking independently of the existing Prestige output bonus.
- Leaderboard and username claiming are more reliable thanks to the new backend and a Content Security Policy fix.
